title: RunConfig
description: meta/run_config.json — the parameters of one run, on disk. A staged run has no caller holding them in memory: `python -m dr2_podcast.stage draft --run <dir>` is a fresh process that has to reconstruct everything the stage needs from the run directory alone. Today those values are function arguments threaded between Prefect tasks (topic_name, language, language_config, target_length_int), which is exactly why the phases cannot be invoked independently.

language.description: Episode language. Drives translation, TTS engine and voice selection. Enumerated rather than any string, because initialise_run_globals indexes SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES with it: a free string let `--language fr` overwrite the run config and only then fail the stage with a KeyError. Rejecting it here means the invalid configuration is never committed. Kept in step with pipeline.SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES by test_the_language_enum_matches_the_supported_languages.
